profile.name: Leonel Mujica
profile.role: QA Lead & Software Engineer in Test
about: Hi! My name is Leonel Mujica and I am a Software engineer with experience in designing, implementing, and testing web and mobile applications. I am a lifelong learner with a passion for exploring different topics, including culture, technology, science, sports, and music.

As a software engineer, I take great pleasure in building and developing technology-based solutions that can make a positive impact on society. Throughout my career, I have gained expertise in automated testing, quality assurance, and test automation frameworks. I am skilled in using a range of tools and technologies to ensure the highest quality standards for software products.

I am excited about connecting with other professionals in the industry and exploring new opportunities to contribute my skills and knowledge. Please feel free to reach out to me if you would like to discuss potential collaborations or opportunities. Thank you for visiting my profile!

recognition: B2B talks on quality processes and ISO certification

projects.name: Playwright Framework
projects.description: End-to-end (E2E) automation framework with a layered architecture (pages, components, fixtures) built on Playwright + TypeScript, with automated failure analysis via Claude Code integrated into the CI/CD pipeline.

projects.name: Cypress Framework
projects.description: BDD end-to-end (E2E) automation framework written in Gherkin and built on Cypress + TypeScript, organised as interaction components and business flows instead of Page Objects, with API seeding and per-scenario test data.

projects.name: Maestro Framework
projects.description: Production-oriented mobile end-to-end (E2E) automation framework built with Maestro, using a public sample app as the initial SUT. Organised around executable smoke and regression journeys, reusable subflows, platform adapters, runtime configuration, and isolated test data—designed to support Android/iOS.
